public_rationale: This is a conditional forecast: if OpenAI cannot meet its obligations, there will be ripples throughout the market. The cited evidence does not show that OpenAI failed to meet its obligations by 28 October 2026. The claim gives no deadline, so the forecast stays open. On 28 April 2026, CNBC reported that AI infrastructure stocks fell after a report that OpenAI had missed internal growth targets (e1). Oracle fell 4%, CoreWeave more than 5% and SoftBank about 10%. OpenAI disputed the report (e1). That market move followed a reported revenue shortfall, not a failure to meet obligations. It does not meet the condition and does not test the forecast.
limitations: The evidence comes from a single search and one source. It is not a full review of counterparty filings or financial news.
The claim sets no timeframe for the condition.
'Ripples' has no defined size or scope, so judging any market reaction will involve some interpretation.

criteria.support_condition: OpenAI fails to meet its obligations, and exposed companies' stocks or credit, or broad markets, then show clear adverse moves tied to the failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI fails to meet its obligations, and markets and exposed companies show no meaningful reaction.
